name: construct-auto-classifier
description: Effect-based safety gate for AI coding agents' shell commands (OpenCode, Antigravity): fast structural rules, then a model (TypeSafe's Jev or a chat LLM) that judges what a command does, not what it is called.
author: godspede

scripts.build: bun build ./src/cli.ts --outfile ./dist/cli.js --target node && bun build ./src/adapters/opencode.ts --outfile ./dist/opencode-plugin.js --target node && bun build ./src/index.ts --outfile ./dist/index.js --target node
